teaser: Yiheng Wang's website, made in one evening by the site factory, five design agents and her own agent: five designs, every claim sourced, all of it her.
core_idea: When a person's work is public and linkable, agents guided by our method can build a spectacular, truthful site for them in an evening, and hand it to the person's own agent.

quotes.text: It's the same job underneath: set the standard, hand out the work, and check the result.
None of this is made up.
She runs her site the way she ran her agents.

figures.caption: Five designs, the same facts: The Profile, Mission Control, The Pass, The Brief, The Journey, and the picker.
One site, three passes, one evening: the factory, five design agents, then Yiheng's own agent.
The first pass, plain and correct, and the second, The Profile: the same facts, made to hire her.
All five designs on a phone: each one rebuilt for a small screen, not shrunk.
Her 26 agents drawn three ways: a live network, a constellation by group, and a kitchen brigade.
The Pass: a prep list, ticket 027, her life as a five-course menu, and a reservation card to book her.
Mission Control: how she works as an incident log, and what she learnt as rules, each quoted from her interview.
The Journey: the kitchen, two weeks from zero, the storm night, and the newsroom, in numbered chapters.
The Brief: one page that prints, key results with sources, competencies mapped to evidence, interview questions.
Use this site with AI: instructions for a hiring manager, for Yiheng, for her AI interviewing her, and for editors.
The site tonight, as Yiheng's own agent left it: The Pass as the home page, her photo, her contact, her CV.
